g.text: Chat run under a grant — happy path (Ack before HTTP; the grantor owns the run)
alias -> team URI; channel concurrency cap;
Ack <= 3 s, BEFORE any embers HTTP
fetch grant; fail-fast: revoked? principal match?
cap already spent today? durable manifest?
mint run_id (UUIDv7); write encrypted request v3
(grantee and payer; never the grantor's key)
Send (bounded, 130 s -- an optimization, never the correctness path)
One atomic join over runsCh + grantsCh:
signer == grantee, not revoked, team matches,
UTC-day counter increments, run registers with
owner = grantor and grant_id — no revocation
Poll and deliver (the sweeper path; also the recovery loop)
sign reveal with the gateway wallet
